subject: general
question: Which of the following screwdrivers has cross-shaped tips that can be used for Phillips recessed head screws?
solution:
**Concept**

 
• Screwdrivers are hand tools designed to provide grip and mechanical advantage in applying torque to turn screws.
 
• They are classified based on the shape of their tips, which must match the corresponding recess in the screw head.
 
• Common types include slotted (flat-head), cross-recess (Phillips), Torx (star), and hexagonal (Allen).

**Explanation**

The Phillips screw is a type of "cross-recess" screw. It was specifically designed to allow the screwdriver to "cam out" (slip out) under excessive torque to prevent over-tightening.
